content.title: 3 Value Stocks We Approach with Caution
content.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason – five cents for a piece of fruit may seem like a great deal until you find out it’s rotten.

content.title: Netflix, Occidental Petroleum, Bumble: Trending Tickers
content.description:
Market Domination host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Allie Canal track several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Netflix (NFLX) facing share pressures this week after Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk called for a boycott over the platform's children's content; HSBC securities and Mizuho analysts both upgrading Occidental Petroleum (OXY) amid Berkshire Hathaway's (BRK-A, BRK-B) deal to acquire OxyChem for $9.7 billion; and shares of dating app Bumble (BMBL) receiving a downgrade.

content.title: Goldman Sachs cuts Bumble on weak turnaround visibility and stiff competition
